### `__constructor`


## Types

### `BandState`

Temporary (one ledger) band reference for a market.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ledger_seq` | `u32` | — |
| `ref_price_bps` | `u32` | — |

### `BreakerConfig`

Per-market circuit breakers, snapshotted at creation from `DataKey::DefaultBreaker`. 0 disables each check. A market without a `Breaker` entry (created before breakers existed) is never checked.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `band_bps` | `u32` | Maximum \|post-price - ledger-open price\| cumulative movement in bps. |
| `max_impact_bps` | `u32` | Maximum \|post-price - pre-price\| a single trade may move in bps. |

### `FeeTerms`

Fee destination and split, snapshotted per market at creation as a side entry (`DataKey::FeeTerms`) so `Market`'s XDR shape never changes. Markets created before this entry existed have no `FeeTerms` and keep the legacy behaviour: `sweep_fees` pays whatever `DataKey::Treasury` holds at sweep time, with the protocol keeping 100% of the fee. That fallback is documented in `sweep_fees` and makes the upgrade migration-free.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `protocol_share_bps` | `u32` | Protocol's share of each trade fee in bps; the rest is the LP's. 0..=BPS. At BPS (the default) the split is exactly today's behaviour. |
| `recipient` | `Address` | Where the protocol's fee share is swept. Frozen at creation: later `set_treasury` calls never redirect fees already earned. |

### `Market`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `Category` | — |
| `close_time` | `u64` | Unix seconds (ledger timestamp). Trading stops at this time. |
| `creator` | `Address` | — |
| `fee_bps` | `u32` | Snapshot of the fee at creation so later config changes never move it. |
| `fees_accrued` | `i128` | Trading fees waiting for `sweep_fees`. |
| `lp_claimed` | `bool` | Creator has withdrawn the pool remainder after finality. |
| `meta_uri` | `String` | IPFS CID / URI of the question metadata. |
| `question_hash` | `BytesN<32>` | sha256 of the canonical question JSON stored off-chain (IPFS), so a client can prove the text it shows is the text that was committed. |
| `reserve_no` | `i128` | — |
| `reserve_yes` | `i128` | — |
| `resolution_hash` | `BytesN<32>` | Commitment to how this market will be resolved, fixed at creation so the creator cannot pick favorable resolution rules after seeing trading activity. The resolver contract verifies a revealed spec against this hash before configuring itself for the market. See `docs/adr/0001-resolution-commitment.md`. |
| `sets_minted` | `i128` | Complete sets in existence == collateral locked for this market. |
| `status` | `MarketStatus` | — |

### `MarketStatus`

| Variant | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Open` | — | Trading allowed until `close_time`, then waiting for the resolver. |
| `Resolved` | `(Outcome)` | Final. Winning shares redeem 1:1. |
| `Void` | — | Invalid market. Every share redeems at 0.5. |

| 9 | `MarketClosed` | — |
| 10 | `NotClosedYet` | — |
| 11 | `NotFinal` | — |
| 12 | `SlippageExceeded` | — |
| 13 | `InsufficientShares` | — |
| 14 | `InsufficientLiquidity` | — |
| 15 | `MarketTooLarge` | — |
| 16 | `NothingToRedeem` | — |
| 17 | `AlreadyClaimed` | — |
| 18 | `Overflow` | — |
| 19 | `DeadlineExpired` | `buy_v2` / `sell_v2` called with `env.ledger().timestamp() > deadline`. |
| 20 | `LimitPriceExceeded` | `buy_v2` / `sell_v2` average execution price worse than the limit. |
| 21 | `PriceImpactTooHigh` | A single trade would move the price more than `max_impact_bps`. (Both this and the band reject the whole invocation, so their events, if any, roll back with it — see the note on `BreakerConfig`.) |
| 22 | `PriceBandExceeded` | Cumulative same-ledger movement would exceed `band_bps`. |
| 23 | `NoPendingWiring` | — |
| 24 | `InvalidWiring` | — |
| 25 | `NoPendingAdmin` | `accept_admin`/`cancel_admin_transfer` called with nothing proposed. |
| 26 | `PendingAdminExpired` | A proposed admin handover was not accepted within its `expires_at`. |

- **Prefix topics:** `"fees_swept"`

- **Indexer filter:** `[Symbol("fees_swept"), "*"]`

### `FeesSweptTo`

Same sweep as `FeesSwept` plus the actual recipient. New event rather than new fields so the existing `FeesSwept` XDR stays stable for indexers; both are emitted on every sweep.

- **Prefix topics:** `"fees_swept_to"`
- **Topic fields:** `market_id: u64`
- **Data fields (`map`):** `recipient: Address`, `amount: i128`
- **Indexer filter:** `[Symbol("fees_swept_to"), "*"]`

Positions moved between holders. Indexers that track balances from `Trade`/`Redeemed` must also apply this event (see docs/architecture.md).

- **Data fields (`map`):** `to: Address`, `outcome: Outcome`, `amount: i128`
- **Indexer filter:** `[Symbol("position_transferred"), "*", "*"]`
